questions.question: How many members are nominated by the President of India in the Rajya Sabha?
Which of the following schedules of the Indian Constitution deals with languages?
Which of the following raw materials for the fertiliser industry is entirely imported as India does not have any reserves?
Which financial innovation is most closely associated with the securitisation of mortgage loans in the banking sector?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Introduction of collateralised debt obligations (CDOs)) है।

questions.question: How many total missions does India's National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) have as of April 2025?
Megasthenes was sent as an ambassador to the court of which of the following Mauryan rulers?
Dr. Purabi Saikia has been awarded the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2024 for her contributions in which field?
The Annual Status of Education Report 2023 revealed higher desire among girls to pursue education beyond _________ as compared to boys.
Mehrunnisa was married to _____ in 1611.
The approximate empirical mass of glucose is _______.
If the average propensity to consume is 60% at national income of ₹100 crores, then what will be the consumption expenditure?
In which year did Girish Chandra Murmu assume office as the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India?
Naked seeds are the characteristic feature of _____________.
Which of the following is a FALSE statement about the Thorn forests?
options: This type of vegetation is found in the north-western part of the country.
Trees are scattered and have long roots penetrating deep into the soil in order to get moisture.
Leaves are mostly thick and small to minimise evaporation.
This forest is spread over the region receiving rainfall between 200 cm and 70 cm.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (This forest is spread over the region receiving rainfall between 200 cm and 70 cm.) है।

questions.question: Who passed an Act in 1898, making it an offence to provoke people against the British rulers?
Who won the Khelo India University Games 2024?

As per the provision of the Constitution (89th Amendment) Act of which year was the National Commission for SC & ST replaced by two Commissions named National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) and National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST)?
Which of the following best describes the 'poverty trap' phenomenon that is often seen in developing economies?
options: A condition where poverty is alleviated through short-term government subsidies
A temporary phase where poverty levels fluctuate due to market volatility
A situation where individuals cannot escape poverty due to a lack of resources and opportunities
A cyclical pattern where economic growth leads to a temporary reduction in poverty
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (A situation where individuals cannot escape poverty due to a lack of resources and opportunities) है।

questions.question: Which constitutional amendment incorporated the Fundamental Duties into the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (42nd Constitutional Amendment) है।

questions.question: 1347 में, बहमनी सल्तनत की स्थापना किसने की थी?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (अलाउद्दीन हसन बहमन शाह) है।
